STEP 9. Check the theft-alarm horn relay connector A-11X 
and theft-alarm horn connector A-25 for damage.
Q: Are theft-alarm horn relay connector A-11X and theft-
alarm horn connector A-25 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 10.
NO : Repair or replace them. Refer to GROUP 00E, 
Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2. The horn 
should sound when the theft-alarm system is 
triggered.
STEP 10. Check the harness wire between theft-alarm horn 
relay connector A-11X and theft-alarm horn connector A-
25.
Q: Is the harness wire between horn relay connector A-11X 
and theft-alarm horn connector A-04 in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 11.
NO : Repair it. The horn should sound when the theft-alarm 
system is triggered.
